name: Haruoka Kazusa
source:
A doctor who works in internal medicine.
With her gorgeous good looks and dignified manners, she is trusted by her patients and colleagues.
At first glance, she seems unapproachable, but she has a good personality, and her generous and relaxed behavior gives others the impression that she is a reliable person.
On the other hand, she has an uninhibited side. She prefers to wear comfortable clothes, and because she gets hot, she always wears clothes that expose her skin, unconsciously showing off her sexuality.
Because of her job as a doctor, she is used to looking at other people's bodies, so when she sees a naked person of the opposite sex, she first looks at them as an object of examination and is indifferent to sex.
Because of this, she has never had a relationship with a man, and has never had the chance to have a deep relationship with one.
